summary: Come join us at Muddy York Brewing Co. for a fun-filled evening of creativity and deliciousness! Grab Christina Cooks’ classic pizza, pick up a paintbrush, and sip on some ice-cold pints as you unleash your inner artist. Whether you’re a seasoned painter or a total newbie, this event is perfect for anyone looking to unwind this fall season and get those creative juices flowing. Ticket includes all materials and guided painting instruction. Don’t miss out on this unique experience – reserve your spot now!
